skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding practical issues related to human resource economics
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and generalize practical issues related to human resource economics at the national and local levels.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying theoretical knowledge to evaluate and forecast changes in the labor market
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical knowledge to evaluate and forecast changes in the labor market under changing environmental factors.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Organize steps for conducting research on human resource economics.
